verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in, in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks. The official MCP server only lets external AI tools like Cursor or Claude call GrowthBook, which belongs to a different story. The 'AI Visual Editor' is only named, with no evidence that a user can hand it tasks. The Cmd+K command palette is navigation, not an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
